title: Instalments Still to Fall on the Schedule of a Covered Holding
content:
Where a Pass and Trip Protection plan rides on the instalment schedule of the holding it is written over, the
instalments still to fall on that schedule are counted from the covered holding's own tier and account under
the Season Pass Programme.

1. Where the covered holding's account shows instalments charged in the season and the holding stands active,
   the instalments still to fall are the number of instalments the holding's tier holds less the number its
   account shows charged in the season.
2. Where the covered holding's account shows no instalment charged in the season and the holding stands
   active, the instalments still to fall are the whole number of instalments that holding's tier holds.
3. In every other case the instalments still to fall are 1.

**What the two questions are.** The first is whether the covered holding's own account under the Season Pass
Programme carries, within the season, any entry charging an instalment; the second is whether the covered
holding itself stands active. A covered holding standing in any condition other than active falls to the third
case whatever its account shows.

**Condition table (hypothetical inputs).**

| Instalments charged on the covered holding's account this season | The covered holding stands active | Instalments still to fall |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 4, on a tier holding 10 | Yes | 6 |
| 0, on a tier holding 10 | Yes | 10 |
| 4, on a tier holding 10 | No | 1 |
| 0, on a tier holding 10 | No | 1 |
